- Developer: Ganesh Housing Limited
- Location summary: Behind Nirma University, off SG Highway, Ahmedabad, within the wider Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar-GIFT City corridor; the project is not inside GIFT City.

## Source policy

Project facts are checked against official project/developer material, company or stock-exchange disclosures, government documents and credible reporting. Reported, announced, fit-out and current-operation statuses are kept distinct. Commercial availability, specifications and legal or tax implications must be independently verified before a decision.
